name: Facet
text: Choose a **fixed dark theme with adjustable accent brightness**—deep blue base, from dim to neon. This guarantees consistency across the interface, matching Manus’ competitive analysis and Graphify’s dark theme while letting users control glare. Trade-off: fixed theme reduces flexibility for future brand colors, but liveliness and clarity win over long-term uniformity.

name: Pane
text: Fixed dark themes with adjustable accents still risk glare in bright environments—users will tweak brightness to extremes, defeating the purpose. A better alternative: **auto-adjusting contrast based on ambient light**, like Manus’ interactive data viz, but with a hard ceiling to prevent neon overload. Settle it with a live demo: measure glare under three lighting conditions and compare glare complaints between fixed and adaptive themes.
